provenance_authentication_requirements.minimum_evidence: Dated field notebook or specimen accession book with original target ID, documented creator and reliable source custody
Physical voucher/container inspection with original target ID and custody/storage handoff trace
Signed original journal/attestation or independent institutional roster directly linked to each target accession
Original camera/RAW provenance or verified named author attestation linked to exact original file hash
Specific written licence/permission from verified rights holder for intended research/public distribution; Drive access is not permission
Independent crossmatch of material and physical labels to earlier accession and 26-file records

limitations: Bounded accessible Google Drive and Gmail searches cannot demonstrate universal absence. General record mentions of Rutgers, voucher, photo, consent and permission cannot authenticate a specific target accession; image metadata lacks attribution/date. R18 research CI tests committed assertions and inherited media; does not automatically fetch new restricted Drive JPEGs or validate independent physical custody.
